about_short_description.short_description: Signadot is a K8s-native ephemeral environment and validation platform built for agentic workflows at scale.

product.name: Signadot Platform
product.description: A Kubernetes-native platform for creating request-isolated sandboxes and validating microservice changes against real dependencies in existing clusters.

product.name: Signadot Sandboxes
product.description: Lightweight, isolated Kubernetes environments that run changed services against shared, production-like dependencies for development, previews, and testing.

product.name: Signadot Smart Tests
product.description: Managed API validation that compares sandbox and baseline behavior to identify meaningful regressions, breaking changes, and contract violations.

product.name: Signadot Jobs
product.description: Kubernetes-native execution infrastructure for running existing Playwright, Cypress, Postman, k6, Selenium, or custom test suites against sandboxes.

product.name: Signadot Plans
product.description: Reusable validation workflows that combine test and automation actions into deterministic, agent-invokable checks for code changes.

product.name: Local Development
product.description: A workflow for running services on a developer workstation while routing requests to real dependencies in a remote Kubernetes cluster.
